notes.title: Fat Goblins Bot & Stability Playtest! June 27-30
notes.content:
When
Fri June 27, 14:00 PDT (UTC-7) → Sun June 30, 14:00 PDT


Where
Request access on the Fat Goblins Steam Page and download the build when the playtest opens


What's being tested
Network stability

New server cluster + congestion fixes

Steamworks integration

Friend invites, lobby parties, rich presence

Voice chat

Proximity goblin-styled voice chat

Death voice chat

Hear peoples reactions if opted-in when they die

AI bots

Prototype goblin bots fill empty slots for matchmaking

New dungeon map

Potentially testing the new dungeon map with the PvPvE dragon boss

This might not make it into this upcoming playtest, we will see


How to help[olist]
Join anytime during the 72-hour window and play a few matches

If you hit disconnects or glitches, post in the Fat Goblins Discord

Drop additional feedback in Fat Goblins Discord
[/olist]


See you on the battlefield!
